admission.justification: Spans record_landing.py and landing_briefs.py, is verified by test_recorded_landing_briefs_refreshes_matching_head_and_reports_unpulled, and keeps PR-landed brief freshness honest within the file-brief family.

applicability: External-memory pull-request landings recorded through worktree_record_landing after record_landed_integration succeeds.
conditions: Refreshes briefs/ only on checked-out memory worktrees whose HEAD commit equals the recorded landed memory commit.
Returns an explicit advisory briefsProblem naming the manual agents-remember memory-briefs command when no checked-out worktree has pulled the landed memory commit.
exclusions: Does not run git pull, fetch, or modify Git refs in any checked-out memory worktree.
Dry runs and already-recorded short-circuit calls do not perform brief refresh.
statement: Recorded pull-request landings refresh briefs on every checked-out worktree whose HEAD matches the landed memory commit and explicitly report an advisory briefsProblem naming the manual refresh command when no checkout matches.
title: Recorded PR landing briefs refresh on matching HEAD and unpulled notice
